decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting builds directly on the firm's long-standing marine and specialty lighting know-how, so it can interpret customer feedback and refine the system, which justifies keeping this long-cycle defense product.

This second-generation interior luminaire is an incremental update to an established product line, giving the firm deep related knowledge to absorb market feedback, though it moved from its own page to a mere mention.

The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics was promoted as a latest release in 2024 and draws on optics and luminaire expertise the firm already holds, so it remains a promising learning platform.

The marine searchlight fits the firm's core marine lighting knowledge and likely replaces the dropped HMI version with newer technology, though overlap within the searchlight range adds some risk of being cut.
